title: Monkey eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- monkey body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='72' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 28 72)'/>
  <!-- right arm holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='68' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-30 72 68)'/>
  <!-- left hand -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='62' r='6' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- right hand -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='56' r='6' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- snack: banana -->
  <path d='M74 50 Q88 44 86 56 Q84 64 76 60 Q70 56 74 50Z' fill='#FFD93B' stroke='#E8B800' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M86 56 Q90 54 88 58 Q86 62 84 60' fill='#A07020'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='26' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='36' r='9' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='36' r='5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='36' r='9' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='36' r='5' fill='#C49A6C'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2B1A0A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2B1A0A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#E0B88A'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#6B3F16'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#6B3F16'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 55 Q50 60 55 55' fill='none' stroke='#6B3F16' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='48' r='3' fill='#D97B6C' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='48' r='3' fill='#D97B6C' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 92 Q12 92 14 78 Q16 68 24 72' fill='none' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hair tuft -->
  <path d='M46 16 Q50 8 54 16' fill='#8B5A2B' stroke='#6B3F16' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
